hero.title: Property Management & Guest Experience in La Fortuna
hero.subtitle: Thoughtfully managed homes, exceptional stays, and personalized experiences in the heart of Costa Rica.

intro.title: A More Thoughtful Approach to Hospitality
intro.p1: We are a La Fortuna company that looks after homes and the people who stay in them. Owners get professional care and clear communication. Guests get a well-prepared home and someone local to call.
intro.p2: Every property is handled as if it were our own, with the same attention given to a booking calendar as to a fresh set of linens.

b1.title: Listings that represent the home
b1.text: Clear descriptions, strong photography and active management across the main booking platforms.

b2.title: Pricing that follows demand
b2.text: Rates reviewed against season, events and local demand rather than set once and left alone.

b3.title: Care between every stay

concierge.title: Beyond the Stay
concierge.lede: From the volcano to a quiet dinner at home, we arrange the details so your days run smoothly.

approach.statement: We manage vacation rentals the way a good hotel is run: with clear standards, steady communication and care that continues between bookings.
approach.text: You keep ownership and control of your home. We handle the listings, the guests, the team on the ground and the numbers, and we keep you informed throughout.

inspections.title: Property inspections

inventory.title: Inventory management

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.updated: Draft for review. Last updated: to be confirmed.
privacy.metaDescription: How Natura Homes handles the personal information you share through this website.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: When you use a form on this site we collect the details you enter, such as your name, email, phone or WhatsApp number and your message, together with the page you sent it from.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: We use this information only to reply to your request and, if you become a client, to provide our services. We do not sell your information.

sections.title: Who receives it
sections.body: Messages are delivered to our team through the email or messaging services we use to operate. These providers process the data on our behalf.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep inquiry information for as long as needed to respond and manage any resulting relationship, and then delete it.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask to access, correct or delete your information at any time by contacting us. Costa Rica's Law 8968 on the protection of personal data applies.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For privacy questions, contact Natura Homes using the details on our About & Contact page.

terms.updated: Draft for review. Last updated: to be confirmed.
terms.metaDescription: Terms that apply to the use of the Natura Homes website.

sections.title: Information on this site
sections.body: We aim to keep property and service information accurate, but details, availability and prices can change and are confirmed only in writing at the time of booking or offer.

sections.title: Bookings
sections.body: Stays booked through third-party platforms are governed by that platform's terms. Direct bookings are governed by the agreement provided at the time of booking.

sections.title: Real estate
sections.body: Real estate information is provided for reference and does not constitute an offer. Buyers should carry out their own due diligence.

sections.title: Intellectual property
